transcript: Being negative can slowly destroy your life, and I do not say this to scare you. I say this because the body is always listening. Every time you wake up thinking something bad will happen, your body believes you. Every time you focus on what is missing, who hurt you, what went wrong, and what may fall apart, your mind becomes trained to expect pain. And after many years, this does not feel like negativity anymore. It feels like your personality. But listen carefully. It is not your personality. It is a pattern. A pattern your nervous system learned because life disappointed you too many times. So now, even when something good comes, you do not enjoy it. You question it. You wait for it to leave. And this is how negativity steals from you, little by little. It steals your sleep. It steals your energy. It steals your patience. It steals your ability to feel peace because the mind that always expects disaster will keep telling the body to prepare for war. And a body preparing for war cannot feel safe, but your mind can be trained again. Gratitude is not pretending life is perfect. It is teaching your brain to notice what is still good. Every morning, before you touch your phone, name three things that are still okay. Your breath, your home, your body still trying. Do this long enough and your mind will stop searching only for danger. You are not too old to change. You are not too damaged to heal. If you want to rebuild your mind for the next 30 days, I put my 30-day healing journey in the link on my profile.
